text: The mappings of the project and their buttons: project properties, new mapping; the open mapping can be renamed (✎) or deleted (✕).
The views of a mapping: rules, lookups, paths and golden cases.
Target: the field of the output this row fills.
Source: where the value comes from in the input.
Expression: how it is computed, when it is not a plain copy.
The schemas of the mapping; green means it is found and readable.
Save writes the file; Check reports what is missing or wrong.
